subject: Quick demo + 15m office hours for Redwood inference evaluation
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@orionpay.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in a short demo — evaluating Redwood for ranking inference

Hi Elliot,

I signed up for a trial this morning (trying to evaluate lower-latency options for our ranking model). I’m Sanjay — engineering lead at OrionPay. We’re looking at moving some on-device/batch work to a hosted inference pipeline and want to understand throughput/latency tradeoffs and costs.

Would appreciate a short walkthrough of Redwood (how batching/prefix caching would look for us). I’m most interested in a compact, 15–20 minute call to cover architecture and quick perf expectations.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Engineering Lead, OrionPay
sanjay@orionpay.com
From: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@orionpay.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-04T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a short demo — evaluating Redwood for ranking inference

Hi Sanjay — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for signing up and for the note.

We can do a compact 15-minute office-hours-style walkthrough that focuses on the topics you mentioned: batching, KV/prefix caching, and cost/latency tradeoffs for ranking. If that works, here are a couple of options:
- Today 11:30–11:45 PT
- Tomorrow 09:00–09:15 PT

If neither fits, you can pick any 30-minute slot on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min — I usually reserve the 30-min slot if the discussion needs an AE deep-dive.

I’ve attached a one-pager that summarizes typical latency/cost ranges by model class (redwood-factsheet.pdf). I’ll keep this thread short — looping Tessa (SDR) to coordinate the invite and an AE touch if needed.

Best,
Elliot Price
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
elliot_price@redwood.ai
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@orionpay.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-04T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a short demo — evaluating Redwood for ranking inference

Hey Elliot — thanks, and apologies — I had to hop into a deploy window this morning and missed the earlier window. Tomorrow 09:00 PT would work better for me but I’d prefer to keep it to 15 minutes if possible — just a focused set of questions: current batching behavior, how KV cache behaves across short sequences, and an example of cost math for 1M queries/day.

If your AE (cc’d) can drop two datapoints I’ll be well prepared.

Quick note: our stack is mostly Python services (FastAPI) and we push models from an MLOps pipeline. We’re in IST (UTC+5:30) — 09:00 PT tomorrow is 21:30 IST, which is doable.

— Sanjay
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@orionpay.com>
Cc: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-05T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a short demo — confirming 15m office hours (09:00 PT)

Hi Sanjay — thanks for confirming. I’ve booked a 15-minute office-hours slot for tomorrow at 09:00 PT (redwood-officehours-15m.ics attached). Karthik (AE) will join the call briefly to share cost/throughput examples.

Agenda (15m):
- 2m: quick intros
- 8m: Elliot walkthrough on batching/KV cache behavior
- 3m: Karthik: example cost/throughput ranges for 1M q/day
- 2m: next steps (trial benchmarks / follow-up 1:1)

Attachments: redwood-officehours-15m.ics (invite), perf-quick-sheet.pdf (two example configs & cost math).

If you want us to focus on any one item more, reply with a short note and we’ll adjust. See you tomorrow.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
SDR, Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@orionpay.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-05T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a short demo — confirming 15m office hours (09:00 PT)

Perfect, thanks Tessa — confirmed. A couple of quick asks so we get the most out of 15 minutes:
- Please prioritize batching behavior when sequence lengths are ~64 tokens (typical requests)
- If possible, bring an example of observed p50/p95 latency with and without KV cache on an A100-style instance
- Any logs or request/response sizes handy would help (even sanity numbers)

See you at 09:00 PT / 21:30 IST.

Sanjay Patel
Engineering Lead, OrionPay
sanjay@orionpay.com
